The '''Sagma system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]]. Situated within the borders of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], by [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was situated in territory controlled by [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] prevailed over a swarm of [[Sikurdian privateers/Legends|Sikurdian pirates]] at the [[Battle of Sagma]] there, and the Empire was later also victorious in an [[Battle of the Sagma system|engagement]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought in the Sagma system.

==Description==
The Sagma system was located in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], which linked it to the [[Mirial system/Legends|Mirial system]] as well as the [[Sikurd system/Legends|Sikurd system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:Listehol_Campaign.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Battle of Sagma of the Listehol Campaign was fought in the Sagma system.]]
During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Sagma [[Star system/Legends|system]] fell within the territory controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with the [[Eleventh Army|Eleventh Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] being tasked with engaging the Confederacy's [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] in the system's vicinity. By [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the Sagma system fell within the territory held by [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the system was the site of the [[Battle of Sagma]], an engagement of the [[Listehol Campaign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Reconquest of the Rim]], in which an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] prevailed over a swarm of [[Sikurdian privateers/Legends|Sikurdian pirates]] before advancing [[spinward]] along the Listehol Run.<ref name="EGTW" /> Years later, at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Empire also emerged victorious in a [[Battle of the Sagma system|battle]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought in the Sagma system against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sagma system was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine that placed the system in the [[Galpos sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] subsequently placed the Sagma system in grid square Q-4,<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book later overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by instead establishing that the system was located in the Illisurevimurasi sector.<ref name="EAOC" />
